Hackathon {Tech: Europe} Agentic AI Hack Zurich today, live demo 20:00. The iPhone app "Orb Agent" (SwiftUI, frontend/BeaverAgent) has an orb with the states idle, listening, thinking, searching and speaking.
The orbs should look exactly like the Orb effect from Libraries.dev ("thinking-orbs"), implemented just like that. The captain pasted its description:
Install: npm install thinking-orbs. Usage: <ThinkingOrb state="searching" size={64} />. Props: state "working" | "searching" | "solving" | "listening" | "connecting" | "weaving" | "composing" | "breathing" | "shaping"; size 64 (chat-avatar scale) or 20 (inline-text scale), each separately tuned; speed multiplies the animation clock, default 1; dark picks the light or dark tuning; paused freezes the animation. Keep the MIT notice and attribution in a THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md under frontend/ and a header comment in the ported file.
- Port all nine states as a reusable SwiftUI view ThinkingOrb(state:size:speed:dark:paused:) with both size tunings (64 and 20), and scale the 64 tuning up cleanly for the large main orb.
- Map the app states in OrbView: idle -> breathing, listening -> listening, thinking -> solving, searching -> searching, speaking -> composing; dark follows the color scheme. Keep OrbView's public API and the status pill unchanged so other workers' code still compiles.
- Scope: OrbView.swift plus new files under frontend/BeaverAgent/BeaverAgent/Orb/. Another worker edits the main screen and session for microphone and playback on feature/wp1-ios-voice; do not touch those files. No new packages, no WebView.
